content: VERIFIED from official docs (nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/instrumentation, v16.3.4, fetched 2026-09-08): register() is called ONCE when a new Next.js server instance is initiated and MUST COMPLETE before the server handles requests - long work in register delays readiness; it runs per server instance (per PM2 instance, and on dev rebuilds) and in BOTH nodejs and edge runtimes (guard with process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME). onRequestError exists for server error capture. Confirms pitfalls: removing cron from instrumentation.ts must also remove it from every runtime path; anything left in register runs once per instance with no leader election.
